Durand Cup 2026 to feature 24 teams starting July 25

The Durand Cup 2026 football tournament is scheduled to commence on July 25, featuring 24 participating teams. Seven teams will be making their debut in the competition. Prominent clubs East Bengal and Mohun Bagan are among the headline participants.
